verdict.rationale: Persona documents a Government ID Verification resource in its API reference and says you can 'fetch specific verification details' through the API. Accounts are also described as grouping all information collected from a user. Together these imply that ID data is retrievable beyond a pass/fail status, but no item states which extracted fields are returned or that they come back as structured data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of extracted fields (name, date of birth, document number, address, expiry) in the verification payload, a field-level schema or example response, and independent or hands-on confirmation of extraction quality.
